system.description:
Effect: Until you use a one-houror longer recovery, you are disguised as another person. About half of these cyphers allow you to disguise yourself as a person you’ve interacted with (your choice of who), and the other half have a preset generic disguise (such as a security guard, business person, or store clerk). Disguise tasks to pretend to be that person are eased by two steps.

Genre Items: oil of the doppelganger (fantasy); biomorphic restructurer (sci-fi) Some disguise modules take a couple of minutes to fully change your appearance, either to or from the disguise.
